standard_prerequisites.name: Fully faithful functor
standard_prerequisites.statement: A functor is fully faithful when its action on each hom-type is an equivalence.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the conclusion, and fullness is the part left to be shown here.

standard_prerequisites.name: Essentially surjective and full
standard_prerequisites.statement: H is essentially surjective and full when preimages exist up to truncation and the action on hom-types is surjective.
standard_prerequisites.use: Both hypotheses are consumed in the proof, fullness at source lines 1405 and 1424.

standard_prerequisites.name: Contractibility is a mere property
standard_prerequisites.statement: To show a type is contractible it suffices to show it is inhabited and a mere proposition, and truncations may be stripped when the goal is a proposition.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the structure of the argument around the displayed type at source line 1397.

core_obligations: Prove fullness: given gamma : F H -> G H and b : B, show that the type of g : hom_C(F b, G b) together with the compatibilities displayed at source lines 1397-1399 is contractible.

Inhabitation: use that contractibility is a mere property and H essentially surjective to assume a_0 and h : H a_0 = b, take g := G h o gamma_{a_0} o inv(F h), and for any other a and f use fullness of H to obtain k with H k = inv(h) o f, then conclude by the displayed three-term chain (source lines 1401-1413).

Mere proposition: for two candidates g, g' it suffices to show g = g', and since that is a proposition one may again assume a_0 and h, in which case both are equal to G h o gamma_{a_0} o inv(F h) (source lines 1414-1418).

Define delta : F -> G by taking delta_b to be the unique g, and verify naturality by assuming preimages for b and b' and using fullness of H to lift the morphism between them, closing with the displayed five-term chain (source lines 1420-1437).
Finally check that delta composed with H is gamma by applying the definition at a and the identity morphism (source lines 1438-1439).

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce to fullness and show the displayed type is inhabited.
Show it is a mere proposition, hence contractible.
Define the filler and verify naturality using fullness again.
Check the composite with H recovers gamma.

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 9.9.2 at source lines 1390-1392: if H is essentially surjective and full then precomposition with H is fully faithful. The author's proof (source lines 1393-1439) is a long argument that avoids the axiom of choice by characterising the value to be defined: it exhibits a type of candidates with compatibility data (lines 1397-1399), proves it contractible in two stages, first inhabitation using essential surjectivity and fullness (lines 1401-1413) and then propositionality (lines 1414-1418), defines the natural transformation by the unique candidate (lines 1420-1421), verifies naturality by lifting a morphism along fullness (lines 1422-1437), and closes by checking that the composite with H is the original transformation (lines 1438-1439). Both hypotheses of the statement are used twice and in different ways, which the statement does not record.
